notes: 40 web calls used (19 WebSearch, 21 WebFetch). Pass A on careers.pennmedicine.org/search/nurse-practitioner-physician-assistant/jobs worked via WebFetch (25 NP/PA listings on page 1 of 75, none pediatric) even though the engine's jobs.json fetch fails; Penn Medicine entities are marked checked on that basis but only page 1 was read. WebFetch would not return verbatim posting text, so every description is a structured extract and raw_notes says so. Six hospitals unreachable: no employer board or postings found via search and no pass A within budget.

url_fixes.why: Saint Peter's job board is careers.saintpetershcs.com (postings at /search/jobdetails/<slug>/<guid>; applications on saintpeters.csod.com, i.e. Cornerstone OnDemand). Set careers_platform to cornerstone.
careers.wellspan.org is dead; WellSpan posts on joinwellspan.org (SilkRoad, 'Tracking Code' IDs, paths /jobs/<Title>/<loc>/<n>/<id>). Many peds APP postings live there.
Hoboken UMC is CarePoint Health; jobs are on the CarePoint iCIMS board (careers-carepointhealth.icims.com/jobs/<id>/...). Set careers_platform to icims.
Saint Clare's is owned by Prime Healthcare; postings are on careers-primehealthcare.icims.com. Filter by Denville in the adapter. Set careers_platform to icims.

Mount Nittany has two iCIMS boards: provider-mountnittany.icims.com (APP/CRNP/physician) and careers-mountnittany.icims.com (staff). The provider board was fetchable and lists APP/CRNP category jobs (IDs like 2024-6228). Set careers_platform to icims.
templehealth.org/careers is a landing page with no listings; it links to the SilkRoad job board at jobs.silkroad.com/templehealth/Careers. Set careers_platform to silkroad.
kidspeace.org/careers has no listings; it links to a HealthcareSource Position Manager board (JS-rendered, needs browser). Set careers_platform to healthcaresource.
Children's Home of Pittsburgh posts on Paylocity Recruiting; this is the all-jobs list for the organization. Set careers_platform to paylocity.

Provider/APP recruiting postings live on guthrie.org under /jobs/<specialty>/<slug> (this one confirmed live today); the Oracle hcmRestApi path 404s. Suggest a specialty-page crawl of guthrie.org/jobs/pediatrics (unverified) rather than the Oracle adapter for APP roles.

No change verified, but note: the Bayhealth Kent NICU is staffed by Nemours Children's Health, so NNP postings for this hospital appear on Nemours boards and AAP/NANN career centers, not on bayhealth.org. Consider attributing Nemours postings located in Dover, DE to this slug.

URL is correct; the HTML category page is readable by WebFetch (25 listings per page, 75 pages, IDs in /jobs/<id>-<slug>) even though /search/jobs.json fails in the engine browser. Suggest the careersite adapter fall back to parsing the HTML list pages with ?page=N. Applies to all five Penn Medicine slugs.
careers.englewoodhealth.org is SuccessFactors (postings at /job/<Title>/<id>-en_US/); the standard SuccessFactors search path is /search/?q=. Unverified within budget.
